Message:
Today, Gracie and I
are gonna clean aaall
the windows in the mansion.
After we’re done,
I bet they’ll be
shinier than ever!

Hmm...
I think I’m supposed
to wipe in circles,
just...like...this...

“My, it looks like you’ve
really taken to cleaning.”

Hehehe! Gracie just said
I’m doing a good job!
I’m so happy!

“Did someone teach you
how to do this?”

Mommy... Daddy...
Will I...never be able
to see them again?

Here I am having all this fun...
but they—

Oh, no. Gracie looks worried.
That’s no good... I have to smile.

After all...I promised them.
That I’d keep smiling,
no matter what.

But...no matter how hard
I tried to smile,
I couldn’t stop crying...

“Shiloh... There’s no sense in
forcing yourself to smile.”

Gracie pulled out
her handkerchief,
dabbing gently at my tears.

“Let me guess...
Were you thinking
about your parents?”
